title: Twelve Monkeys Kanzi Iced Shorfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Kanzi Iced by Twelve Monkeys is a refreshing take on a classic fruit medley, blending the succulent sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the juicy, mouthwatering taste of Watermelon. A tangy twist of Kiwi adds a subtle tartness, while a cool menthol exhale enhances the overall freshness, delivering a crisp and satisfying vape. Designed with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, Kanzi Iced is perfect for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, ensuring rich vapour production and full-bodied flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, this e-liquid allows vapers to customise their nicotine strength to suit their preference. If you prefer this flavour without the cooling sensation, the original un-iced version is also available right here at Vapestore. Twelve Monkeys is a globally recognised Canadian e-liquid brand, celebrated for its masterfully blended fruit flavours. Each e-liquid is crafted with high-quality ingredients to provide a consistently premium vaping experience.
